page.overview:
What is Tarountula?

Tarountula is a greenish-yellow arachnid whose bulb is coated in webbing It has eight legs that are split into sets of four, with each leg bearing a green color on the bottom half. It has six eyes, but only the front two possess irises. The irises seems tired or sad most times. Its mouth appears to be made up of four tiny flaps that cover it's gob. Tarountula's natural habitat is in large, shady trees, and their natural enemy is the Scyther. The tensile strength of its webbing is high and is very stretchy like elastic.

Tarountala evolves into Spidops starting at level 15.

Tarountula appears to be based on the and some members of the Uloboridae family, which are non-venomous and wrap their prey in bundles of silk. The silk that wraps up its abdomen into a large ball resembles a yarn ball, though it may be inspired by the spherical pods that create to shelter their eggs. Its shiny coloration resembles the Destiny Knot item.

Its Japanese name, Tamantula, may be a combination of tama (sphere, ball) and tarantula.
